name: pre-award-agent
description: Check BLS and Per Diem readiness, disclose keyless limits, then build a SOW/PWS and IGCE.

interface.longDescription: Reports limited BLS and Per Diem fallback before coordinating scope-only, pricing-only, and end-to-end federal pre-award workflows. It preserves approved handoffs and keeps the contract document separate from the Government estimate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pre-award-workflow. Check BLS/Per Diem. On selection, four-line preview is first visible text; no preface/fence.
